    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersMemphis dry rub barbecue wingsCrisp baked wings in smoky paprika dry rub, barbecue mustard dipHow to make it2 tbsp smoked paprika2 tbsp brown sugar1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp onion powder1/2 tsp cayenne pepper1.2kg chicken wings2 tsp baking powder150ml barbecue sauce2 tbsp American mustard1 tbsp cider vinegarMix the paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne and salt.Toss the wings with baking powder and the rub.Bake on a rack at 220°C, turning once.Mix the barbecue sauce, mustard and vinegar for dipping.98th percentile devilled eggsCreamy pickle yolk filling topped with crisp bacon and chivesHow to make it8 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp American mustard1 jar of dill pickles3 rashers of bacon1 tsp smoked paprika1 bunch of chivesCook the eggs in boiling water.Cool in iced water, then peel.Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl.Mash with mayonnaise, mustard, chopped pickles and salt.Pipe back into the whites.Grill the bacon until crisp and crumble.Top the eggs with bacon, a dusting of smoked paprika and chives.MainsTuohy Thanksgiving turkey at the tableHerb butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffingHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast120g butter1 bunch of sage300g cornbread1 onion2 celery sticks1 egg450ml chicken stock1kg potatoes100ml full cream milk300g green beans1 tbsp plain flour1 jar of cranberry saucePush the herb butter under the skin of the turkey breast.Roast at 180°C until cooked through, then rest.Crumble the cornbread with the fried onion, celery, chopped sage, egg and stock.Bake the stuffing until golden.Peel and chop the potatoes.Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.Blanch the green beans and toss in butter.Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and stock.Serve with cranberry sauce.Thanksgiving baked mac and cheeseThree cheeses and a golden top. Big Mike gets a seat at the tableHow to make it400g macaroni50g butter3 tbsp plain flour750ml full cream milk200g vintage cheddar, grated100g gruyère, grated60g cream cheese1 tsp mustard powder50g panko breadcrumbsGrate the cheeses.Boil the macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Stir in the cheeses, saving a handful, the cream cheese and mustard.Fold through the macaroni, tip into a baking dish and scatter with the saved cheese and the panko.Bake at 200°C until bubbling and golden.SweetsFerdinand the Bull pecan piePecan pie with a sticky brown sugar and golden syrup fillingHow to make it1 sheet shortcrust pastry3 eggs150g brown sugar150ml golden syrup50g butter1 tsp vanilla extract200g pecans1 L vanilla ice creamLine a 23cm pie dish with the pastry.Bake blind at 190°C.Whisk the eggs, brown sugar, golden syrup, melted butter, vanilla and salt, then stir in the pecans.Pour into the case.Bake at 170°C until just set with a slight wobble.Cool for 1 hour and serve with ice cream.DrinksMemphis peach sweet teaSweet black tea with peach nectar, lemon and mint over iceHow to make it6 black tea bags120g caster sugar300ml peach nectar2 lemons1 peach1 bunch of mint1 bag of iceSteep the tea bags in boiling water with the sugar.Leave to steep, then remove the bags.Cool, then chill until cold.Stir in the peach nectar and lemon juice.Fill glasses with ice and peach slices, pour over the tea and finish with mint and lemon wheels.Bourbon mint julepLeigh Anne's pour, Ole Miss on the TV.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
